rules.name: xoga713-var-accounting-table-values
rules.sql: SELECT BINARY derivative_type AS derivative_type_exact, count(*) AS row_count FROM dbsystemuat.var_accounting_table_cfs WHERE value_date = :vd GROUP BY BINARY derivative_type ORDER BY 1

SELECT derivative_type AS derivative_type_exact, count(*) AS row_count FROM opera.var_accounting_table WHERE upper(business_unit) = 'CFS' AND tenant_id = :tenant AND value_date = :vd GROUP BY derivative_type ORDER BY 1

SELECT upper(derivative_type) AS dtype, settlement_date, subportfolio, p1_name, contract_month, strike, derivative_type AS derivative_type_raw, p1_settleprice, delta, gamma, vega, theta AS settle_theta, mtm_usd, mtm_nc, delta1 AS delta_2, gamma1 AS gamma_2, vega1 AS vega_2 FROM dbsystemuat.var_accounting_table_cfs WHERE value_date = :vd

SELECT upper(derivative_type) AS dtype, settlement_date, subportfolio, p1_name, contract_month, strike, derivative_type AS derivative_type_raw, p1_settleprice, delta, gamma, vega, settle_theta, mtm_usd, mtm_nc, delta_2, gamma_2, vega_2 FROM opera.var_accounting_table WHERE upper(business_unit) = 'CFS' AND tenant_id = :tenant AND value_date = :vd

expect.reason: every legacy row of that date was loaded
no extra row in the new table
values equal; a derivative_type_raw difference means the spelling of derivative_type changed between legacy and the new table
